name: care.findcare/findcare
title: FindCare
description: Free, sourced facts on US clinics for patients, care navigators and AI assistants.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search FindCare, a free directory of US clinics for people with Medicaid, Medicare or no insurance: community health centers, Medicare-certified surgery centers and rural health clinics, and Title X family planning clinics. Takes plain words, such as "dentist that takes Medicaid near Lilburn, GA" or "sliding fee clinic 30047", and reads a place (a 5-digit ZIP code, or a town with its state), a kind of care, a way to pay (Medicaid, Medicare, no insurance, or an insurance company), a type of clinic, a language and open hours. A clinic's name works too. Returns up to 10 clinics as id, title and FindCare profile URL, those confirmed for the payment first, then nearest; fetch gives each one's sourced facts.

query.description: Plain words: the kind of care, where (ZIP code or "City, ST"), and how the person pays.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: One clinic's FindCare profile as text, one fact per line, each with its source and the date it was read or checked: type, address and phone from the government record; whether it takes Medicaid and Medicare and sees people without insurance; lower prices based on income and published prices; new patients, hours, languages, services, and insurance plans named on its website. A fact no source states reads "Not stated by the clinic. Call to ask" with the phone number. Takes an id from search or find_clinics, a CMS certification number (CCN), an NPI, or an HRSA BPHC site number.

id.description: The clinic: an id from search or find_clinics (FindCare ID or profile slug), a FindCare profile URL, a CMS certification number (CCN), an NPI, or an HRSA BPHC site number.

tools.name: find_clinics
tools.description: Clinics near a ZIP code or town, filtered by kind of care, way to pay (and a plan name), type of clinic, a language, and open now, today or on weekends. Clinics confirmed for the chosen payment come first, then by distance; claimed listings never rank higher. With open or language set, clinics that confirm them come ahead of clinics that don't say, and clinics whose hours show them closed are left out. Each clinic has its distance, address, phone, FindCare profile URL, the payment answer with its source, and today's hours. Up to 25 a call; pass next_cursor for more, up to 10 pages.

near.description: A 5-digit ZIP code or a town as "City, ST", for example "Lilburn, GA". Needed unless the client sends the user's approximate location.

radius_miles.description: How far to look. Default: the nearest 10, 25, 50 or 100 miles that hold at least five clinics.

care.description: primary: checkups and sick visits. dental. mental: counseling and behavioral health. eye. surgery: outpatient surgery and procedures. family_planning: birth control, STI and pregnancy tests.

pays_with.description: How the person pays. uninsured means no insurance.

plan.description: An insurance company or plan name, such as "Aetna" or "Peach State Health Plan". Without pays_with it counts as private insurance.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same search.

lang.description: Language of the answer text. Default: English, or Spanish when the client's locale is Spanish.

tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description: Whether one clinic takes a way to pay, or a named plan, and where that comes from. answer is one of: program_rule_yes (a federal rule every clinic of its type must follow, such as every community health center taking Medicaid), record_yes (a government record, such as a Medicare certification), stated_yes or stated_no (the clinic's own website, quoted), organization_stated_yes (the website of the organization that runs the clinic, stated for all its locations, so this one is worth a call to confirm), or not_stated (no source says either way). Returns the quote, source URL, date read, phone and FindCare profile URL. A fact about the clinic, not a decision about anyone's eligibility.

id.description: The clinic: an id from search or find_clinics (FindCare ID or profile slug), a FindCare profile URL, a CMS certification number (CCN), an NPI, or an HRSA BPHC site number.

plan.description: An insurance company or plan name, for medicaid, medicare or private.

lang.description: Language of the answer text. Default: English, or Spanish when the client's locale is Spanish.

tools.name: report_correction
tools.description: Send FindCare a report that a fact about a clinic is wrong or out of date: a phone number that does not work, hours or an address that changed, insurance it no longer takes, a clinic that closed. Nothing changes right away: a person checks each report against the clinic's own records or website before its FindCare page changes. Leave out names, contact details and health information. Returns a report id.

id.description: The clinic: an id from search or find_clinics (FindCare ID or profile slug), a FindCare profile URL, a CMS certification number (CCN), an NPI, or an HRSA BPHC site number.

proposed_value.description: What it should say, or "unknown" if only the current fact is wrong.

note.description: What is wrong and how the reporter knows, in a sentence or two.

evidence_url.description: A page that shows the right fact, such as the clinic's own site.

lang.description: Language of the answer text. Default: English, or Spanish when the client's locale is Spanish.
